findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.comment: Observed that the establishment is hot holding manufactured cheese sauce in a dispenser (opened on day 1, and discarded on day 7), which is beyond the terms of their Category 3A - Low Risk permit, which does not allow for hot holding of any food items. CORRECTED: PIC and Owner were informed, and will cease serving hot held cheese sauce. Please contact SCDPH if establishment plans to change the menu to include food preparation like hot holding. Inspectors suggested acquiring single service shelf stable sauces that can be heated up by customers in the establishment’s microwave.
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the bar hand washing sink did not have paper towels when the inspector arrived. The PIC was informed and they brought a roll of paper towels to the hand washing sink. They were reminded of the importance of hand drying for the proper hand washing procedure. Ensure that paper towels are always available at every handwashing sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed racks of pizza ovens and bottom of popcorn machine to be soiled with food debris. Clean and maintain clean by wash, rinse, sanitize. 
4-602.12: (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure. 
The items were washed rinsed and sanitized during the inspection.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Observed container of single use utensils with handles of utensils down in the container and eating surfaces not protected. Utensils were dumped out and replaced with eating end protected and handles presented for service.
4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed inside of the soda gun drip tray to be soiled. Dismantle tray and clean regularly. The soda gun holder was cleaned at time of inspection. 
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
Ice machine has a white drain line that goes underneath the floor to an unknown location. I asked the owner to get a plumber in to possible air gap the line. Recheck in 7 days.

12/29/17 Spoke with the owner. The drain line runs over to his house, over the wall, then drips onto the floor. The ice machine is air-gapped. Corrected.
